name: Probability Plot
description: Normal probability plot for checking normality, with optional grouping
whenToUse: Check whether one or more numeric columns follow a distribution: points on the straight line mean a good fit.
placeholderText: Select at least one numeric column to create the probability plot. Optionally add a grouping column to compare multiple groups in the same plot.
errNoGroupLevels: Dataset {n}: The grouping column contains no valid values.
